name: Chunk-based Voxel Rendering Pipeline
definition: A high-throughput rendering pipeline that aggregates voxel faces, transforms them to world space, projects them, clips by distance, sorts by depth (Painter's Algorithm), applies visual effects, and rasterizes using polygon drawing.
summary: The Chunk-based Voxel Rendering Pipeline aggregates voxel cubes into static mesh batches uploaded to GPU buffers, separating visibility processing from rendering to reduce draw calls and eliminate hidden faces.
